clean.title: A toy approval rule as a decision tree
clean.body:
The rule asks about age first. Under 30, it asks whether income is over $50,000: yes means Approve, no means Deny. Anyone else goes to a credit score check. A 25-year-old earning $60,000 is under 30 and over the income line, so the result is Approve.

```rh-diagram
{"version":1,"diagram":{"kind":"flow","title":"Toy approval rule","caption":"Age under 30? Yes, then income over $50,000? Yes, so Approve.","nodes":[{"id":"age","label":"Age under 30?","role":"decision"},{"id":"income","label":"Income over $50,000?","role":"decision"},{"id":"approve","label":"Approve","role":"outcome"},{"id":"deny","label":"Deny","role":"outcome"},{"id":"credit","label":"Check credit score","role":"outcome"}],"edges":[{"from":"age","to":"income","label":"Yes"},{"from":"age","to":"credit","label":"No"},{"from":"income","to":"approve","label":"Yes"},{"from":"income","to":"deny","label":"No"}],"highlightPath":["age","income","approve"]}}
```

So this applicant is approved.
